content.title: HPE’s revenue up 14% to $9.7bn in Q4 2025
content.summary: The company's networking revenue rose to $2.8bn, marking a 150% increase, with an operating profit margin of 23%, down from 24.4% previously.

thumbnail.caption: HPE anticipates revenue in the range of $9bn to $9.4bn for the first quarter of fiscal year 2026. Credit: Sundry Photography/Shutterstock.com.

content.title: HPE Falls After Outlook Disappoints on Slower Server Deals
content.summary: Revenue will be $9 billion to $9.4 billion and profit, excluding some items, will be 57 cents to 61 cents in the period ending in January, HPE said Thursday in a statement.  Analysts, on average, projected sales of $9.88 billion and profit of 53 cents, according to data compiled by Bloomberg.  Sales in the fiscal fourth quarter, which ended Oct. 31, also missed analysts’ estimates as some deals for servers to power artificial intelligence workloads were pushed into 2026, Chief Executive Officer Antonio Neri said in an interview.

content.title: HPE Fiscal Q4 Revenue Light Amid Weak Guidance On Delayed AI Server Deals
content.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise reported fiscal fourth-quarter earnings that topped estimates while revenue missed. HPE stock fell on Friday amid January-ending quarterly sales guidance that came in well below expectations as delayed sovereign artificial intelligence server deals impacted revenue.
